description: A Python script that manages the setup of vendor bundles and the Python path for a build system, including version checks and environment configuration.

classes.name: VersionRequirementError
classes.description: Custom exception class for version requirement failures, inherits from SystemExit.

methods.name: setup_path
methods.description: Configures the Python search path based on vendor bundle availability and version requirements.

methods.name: require_invoke_minversion
methods.description: Ensures the 'invoke' package is installed and meets the minimum version requirement.

methods.name: need_vendor_bundles
methods.description: Determines if vendor bundles are needed based on environment and module availability.

methods.name: need_vendor_bundle_invoke
methods.description: Checks if the 'invoke' package version is below the required minimum, indicating a need for vendor bundle.

methods.name: setup_path_for_bundle
methods.description: Adds a bundle path to sys.path if it exists.

methods.name: syspath_insert
methods.description: Inserts a path into sys.path at a specified position, removing duplicates.

methods.name: syspath_append
methods.description: Appends a path to sys.path, removing duplicates.
